description: Build an Ableton-style clip launcher: a grid panel (Container COMP) of clip buttons, one per named cue (from manage_cue), for fast hands-on scene switching during a live set. Open the container in Perform/Panel mode and tap a clip to fire its cue — instantly, or (with morph_time) crossfading to it over N seconds (eased, the same engine manage_cue uses). Store the cues with manage_cue / create_control_panel first.

cols.description: Grid column count. Defaults to ceil(sqrt(cues)) when omitted (derived from cues length).

comp_path.description: Control COMP that holds the cues (manage_cue) and custom params. The launcher panel is built inside it and its buttons fire that COMP's cues.

cues.description: Cue names (stored with manage_cue) to lay out in the grid, in order. Each becomes a clip button labelled with its cue name.

morph_time.description: 0 = each button jumps instantly to its cue; >0 = every button crossfades to its cue over this many seconds (eased morph, same engine as manage_cue).

name.description: Name of the launcher panel container to build.

rows.description: Grid row count. Defaults so rows*cols covers all cues (derived from cues length).

name: create_clip_launcher
title: Create clip launcher
